text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a short config-only change tonight to tighten batching and per-route timeouts. Aim: reduce tail-latency for small-chat workloads without touching model binaries. Quiet window requested 02:00-03:30 UTC.

maya: Proposed changes (small):
```json
{"routes": {"/v1/chat/small": {"batch_max_tokens": 512, "batch_timeout_ms": 18, "per_request_timeout_ms": 2200}}, "routing": {"prefer_region": "closest", "fallback_tier": "cpu-fallback"}, "limits": {"concurrency_per_pool": 160}}
```

maya: TL;DR: smaller batch timeout, slightly higher concurrency cap for small-chat pool, prefer local region routing + explicit fallback to cpu-fallback when gpus saturated.

ian: q: are we pinning model variants? last time mixing variants caused unexpected mem pressure.

maya: yes — pinning small-chat route to `gptq-small:v2.1` for this change. No model mucks.

tara: Can we add a fast rollback key? If latency rises we should immediately revert batch_timeout and concurrency. Suggest a single-click rollback in console + a quick runbook snippet.

maya: agree. Rollback plan: 1) console toggle to revert `batch_timeout_ms` and `concurrency_per_pool` 2) route pin -> previous `gptq-small:v2.0` if needed 3) drain canary nodes via autoscaler hook. I'll add the runbook in the release notes.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: lint OK, canary job queued. CI: https://ci.internal/1234 (artifacts: lint, config-validate).

ian: Also let's gate by p50/p95 in staging for 30m before prod canary. If p95 increases > 12% vs baseline -> abort.

maya: done. Gate set in deploy config. Canary plan: 3 waves (10% -> 30% -> 100%) with 15-minute observation windows.

ops-oncall: I can take the 02:00 UTC window. If anything flares I'll escalate to eng-oncall.

tara: Added a short note for SRE to monitor: token-cost delta, p99 latency, error-rate by route, and cold-start counts.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout at 02:10 UTC. Canary wave 1 starting in us-west-2.

deploy-bot: wave 1 started — 10% traffic to canary (us-west-2).

maya: watching metrics — initial p95 looks stable, CPU fallback not triggered. Will wait full 15m and report.

deploy-bot: wave 1 success -> progressing to wave 2 (30%).

maya: wave 2 stable. p95 +6% but within gate. Moving to full.

deploy-bot: final wave complete. rollout successful.

maya: Post-deploy notes: keep an eye on small-chat pool concurrency; if p99 climbs > 18% we revert. Otherwise we'll keep the config for 24h and revisit quantization/kv-cache tweaks next week. :white_check_mark:
